hypotheses.paper: singular locus contains full future BTZ rays (B21 Lemma 2.3/2.4)
hypotheses.note: hrays : ∀ p ∈ S0 M, ∃ γ, E0Spear.IsFullFutureBTZRay p γ (DEC-125 (b)), the same hypothesis GX.btzTilde_null_supset carries
as hreg: J+(D y) ⊆ D(J+ y) at regular y, which is the first half of GX.btzTilde_supset_of_reg (Uniformization imports this file, so the regular case enters as a hypothesis)

findings: The prop's proof (l.2350-2352) ends on 'the singular locus contains full future BTZ rays' and leaves implicit how this gives D(J+(x)) = J+(D x) at a BTZ point x along the developed BTZ line. The step needs the ray LIFTED to M~ and D of the lift to be a WHOLE future half-line; the latter holds because the ray is complete for an affine parameter fixed by ONE E0-morphism psi (DEC-125 (b)'s reading): the stabiliser of the axis in Isom(E0) contains boosts rescaling the axis parameter (GX.IsAxisAff, r -> r/lambda, t -> lambda t + ...), so a chain of charts each with its own parameter could a priori develop onto a bounded segment. The proof pins the scale by comparing the chart over gamma([0,T]) with the chart over gamma([0,1]) on their common BTZ fibre, which is one point (Gamma fixes the axis).

labels.label: theo:globally_hyperbolic_cauchy_complete_cauchy_maximal

hypotheses.note: only full future BTZ rays (hrays) and a chartwise M~ are used for this assertion

findings: Certified here: the paper's 'S_x is a totally ordered relatively open future half line, so is its image' in its future half from a BTZ point x: a full future BTZ ray gamma of M from p(x) lifts to M~ from x (z over gamma(lambda/2), x <= z) and D maps the lift ONTO D x + R_+ u, u future null nonzero. Not attempted (outside this package): Delta_x ⊂ ∂Omega, the image formula, M ≅ rho\D(M~).

kb_proposals: An injective E0-morphism psi on an open W of Y, restricted to a box and inverted, is a flat-compatible chart (GX.futureRay_isFlatCompat) and hence an E0-chart of def:atlas for the bridge structure (GX.futureRayHomeo / GX.futureRay_isAEMorphism, the chartAt-free form of E0Bridge.xaHomeo); with a box image it descends (hasMaximalLifts_btzBox).

The BTZ fibre of a lifted descending chart is one point (GX.futureRay_eq_apex_of_orbitMk): two lifted charts through the same x agree there, which is how two charts of a chain are compared without a uniqueness theorem for descents.

In BTZTildeData code, an element of d.D '' d.causality.Jplus ⊤ {x} must be given as ⟨d.toNat z, (h : d.fromNat (d.toNat z) ∈ ...), _⟩: a bare z : d.Space trips the WithWrappedTop / SpreadEnd topology instance check.
